en.title: Why does most of the afore generation retire with guaranteed pension?
en.summary: For all those IMSS contributors whose accumulated resources in their afore are relatively low or insufficient to contract a life annuity or scheduled withdrawal, which are generally workers who contributed with low salaries, the guaranteed pension applies.

pt.title: Por que a maioria da geração afore se aposenta com pensão garantida?

de.title: Warum geht die Mehrheit der Afore-Generation mit garantierter Rente in den Ruhestand?

it.title: Perché la maggior parte della generazione afore si ritira con pensione garantita?
